Shared cyclic itineraries yield exact lambda^k error decay, and permutation symmetry away from measure-zero tie hyperplanes yields equal basins. value.rationale: This is a complete dimension-uniform classification for a geometrically canonical farthest-vertex rule studied in the plane. The shift from polygonal planar models to regular simplices produces factorially many attracting cycles, explicitly parameterized geometric barycentric spectra, a finite global transient and equal physical basin volumes for every contraction strength, not just generic parameters. These facts explain exactly how the farthest-vertex rule organizes multi-dimensional contracting trajectories, beyond either generic asymptotic periodicity or planar examples.
